final.answer: Added one no-op `recordSubscriberInvocationFailure(Throwable)` hook in `Subscriber.java`. It is called exactly once in `dispatchEvent` after `invokeSubscriberMethod(event)` throws `InvocationTargetException` and immediately before `bus.handleSubscriberException(...)`. Successful invocations do not call the hook. Compilation passes.
